exploration_data/reachable_mask.npz.note: Denominator 4,002,095 -> 3,757,990 (-244,105): the REAL-ARC ENVELOPE. Methods B/C bound a jump by a rectangle (rise 183 AND reach 480 at once); no arc does both. Re-derived from 228 measured engine arcs (exploration_data/jump_arcs.npz, tools/collect_jump_arcs.py) with a generous bound (arcs slide along walls, every arc launchable from every standable anchor). It accounts for 99.74% of the 3.16M px of real play on the 14.8M state; the 8,274 px it denies are kept as observed play (exploration_data/observed_reach.npz), so coverage is lossless. The 244,105 removed px are all classified CONNECTIVITY_GAP (model gap, never a glitch). Applied by tools/build_reachability.py --tighten; the previous rectangle-envelope mask is archived at exploration_data/archive_mask_v3_rectangle/reachable_mask.npz.
